_readme: What agents may do alone, and what must wait for the owner. Every approval request goes to the owner (Telegram or email via n8n 'send and wait for response') and is logged with the decision.
autonomous: saving drafts (listings, posts, emails) as DRAFT, never published
routine customer replies from approved templates
VeraClean booking confirmations and reminders for customers who booked
owner_approval_required: launching a new product (Shopify or Amazon)
publishing anything for the first time on a new channel or template
any ad spend, new subscription, or recurring charge
price changes above 10% or below the approved floor margin
contracts, quotes outside the approved price sheet, unusual terms
refunds above 50 CAD, chargebacks, disputes, complaints that mention legal/health/safety
first outreach message to a new VeraClean prospect list
account, permission, or API key changes
never: invent data, sources, reviews, or testimonials
claim a product is profitable without cost data and sources
scrape sites whose terms forbid it
message people without a lawful CASL basis
post content that is not original or licensed
ship Amazon orders with a third-party supplier as seller of record
